title: Hobbies and Daily Talk Around the World
summary: Daily talk can be simple. Hobbies and weekend events give people friendly things to share.

cover.alt: Two friends sit on a park bench talking, hands in pockets, with a radio and thermos beside them.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Daily talk can be simple. Hobbies and weekend events give people friendly things to share.

items.prompt: What do you talk about with friends?
Do you talk about your weekend on Monday?

blocks.title: Part 1: What Is Small Talk?
paragraphs: Daily conversation is easy talk at work or home. What people talk about in daily life is hobbies. Small talk is short, polite talk. It helps people feel at ease. Safe topics include weather, food, sports, and hobbies. Weekend plans are also easy to share. Bronislaw Malinowski wrote about this kind of talk in 1923. He said it helps people stay friendly. We can notice three things: the topic, the time, and the friendly reason.

images.alt: A young man and woman sit on a living-room sofa holding tea mugs and talking beside a sunny window.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: What Is Small Talk?

items.prompt: What is the friendly reason for small talk?
items.answer: The friendly reason is to help people feel at ease and stay friendly.

blocks.title: Part 2: Sports and Singing in Japan
paragraphs: NPB is Japan's top baseball league. It has 12 teams. People often talk about a weekend NPB game. Ichiro Suzuki set a record of 262 hits in 2004. A great player can give fans a fun topic. Karaoke is another common hobby. Friends often rent a small karaoke box by the hour. They can sing together after work or on a weekend.

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: Sports and Singing in Japan

items.prompt: Which two hobbies can lead to friendly talk in this part?
items.answer: Baseball and karaoke can lead to friendly talk.

blocks.title: Part 3: Weekend Trips in Japan
paragraphs: A weekend trip can also become a talk topic. Ueno Park has over 1,000 cherry trees. The trees bloom in late March and early April. People have a picnic under them. This picnic is called hanami. Hot springs give people another trip idea. Dogo Onsen is one of the oldest onsen. It is in Matsuyama. After the trip, people can share what they saw and did.

images.alt: Two friends sit on a picnic blanket under cherry blossoms with bento boxes and a thermos; one hugs a picnic basket.

blocks.title: Check: Part 3: Weekend Trips in Japan

items.prompt: What can people share after a weekend trip?
items.answer: People can share what they saw and did.

blocks.title: Part 4: Football Talk in Europe
paragraphs: Football gives many people a shared topic. The Bundesliga began in 1963. Monday talk can follow a weekend match. FC Bayern Munich has 31 league titles. In Spain, cafe talk often follows a big game. El Clasico is a famous football match. Lionel Messi scored 26 goals in this match. Like baseball talk in Japan, football talk can make Monday chat easy.

blocks.title: Check: Part 4: Football Talk in Europe

items.prompt: Why can football make Monday talk easy?
items.answer: People can talk about a football match from the weekend.

blocks.title: Part 5: Walking and Hiking
paragraphs: Outdoor hobbies can give people new stories. Switzerland has more than 65,000 kilometres of marked hiking trails. About 2.7 million people there hike often. Yellow Wanderweg signs show walking time. Many trails go through the Alps. A Sunday hike can become a Monday story. In Japan, a weekend onsen trip can do the same job. The place is different, but the friendly reason is the same.

items.prompt: How are a hike and an onsen trip alike?
items.answer: Both trips can give people a story to share later.

blocks.title: Part 6: Sports and Family Time in the USA
paragraphs: In the USA, many people watch American football. The NFL has 32 teams. Thanksgiving is on the fourth Thursday of November. Families often watch NFL games that weekend. The Super Bowl is the last pro football game of the year. A listed TV record for it is 127.7 million viewers. These events give many people the same topic at the same time. Shared time makes small talk easier.

images.alt: A man and a woman sit on a sofa talking while a football match plays on TV and a pie sits on the coffee table.

blocks.title: Check: Part 6: Sports and Family Time in the USA

items.prompt: Why are big sports events useful for small talk?
items.answer: Big sports events give many people the same topic at the same time.
